required_chains: actual field/temperature/current/bath records→timestamped raw CCC cycles
started services→independent safe-state observations→accepted return custody→archive
immutability: Raw observations and original service receipts remain immutable. Corrections/derived results carry new versions and explicit supersession; no replacement of failed runs by source outcomes.
no_fake_completion: Review completion, artifact validation, observed source results and service request acceptance are distinct from physical experiment completion.
